metadata.title: Federation Dreadnoughts - MV
metadata.author: Created by PR0T05T33L and modders of the Biodome, ported to multiverse by SuperPako148
metadata.description:
Federation Dreadnought Type A - GFS 'Hailstorm' This massive prototype ship has a 17% tougher hull than most cruisers and is capable of running 25% more energy through the weapons system, allowing it to run a large array of power-hungry weaponry. However, it is incapable of reaching the same speeds as a cruiser.
Federation Dreadnought Type B - 'The Acerbus' This prototype Federation ship was captured by Rock cultists and modified with rare super-hard glowing crystals and devastating weaponry. It was recently recaptured by the Federation, but with the Rebels closing in, there was no time to repair the damage the ship suffered during the recapture.
Federation Dreadnought Type C - 'Regula Ruptor' This prototype Federation ship was stolen by some of the most vicious pirates in the galaxy and its artillery beam replaced with an incredibly powerful EMP emitter. The pirates have agreed to assist the Federation in exchange for their freedom.
This version of the mod is designed for use with FTL: Multiverse. Alternate versions for use with the base game, pure Hyperspace and/or Captain's Edition are also available.
The Acerbus was originally created by Anthonest. This remake of the mod was handled by PR0T05T33L and R30hedron. Thanks go to the other modders of the Biodome Discord server for their advice. Special thanks go to BrenTenkage for sharing the original mod halfway through development. Some assets were borrowed from Captain's Edition and others were borrowed from the Buteogallus mod by steamtex. Porting to multiverse and accompanying balancing changes were done by SuperPako148.
